name: Dungeon Bucko
storyline:
A dark power has creeped into the land of Ami. The Goddess Amiya is attacked by it and sends you, her faithful bucko servant away with the last of her magic powers to the fabled Hall of Buckos. Where the finest champions of time are preserved for such needed battles.

Gather brave heroes and venture forth to the dark tower and rescue Amiya and save the land in the process!
summary: Dungeon Bucko is a retro styled dungeon crawler an homage to games like Dungeon Master. Based on Amiya Aranha's community. It was created for the 2026 Buckojam and turned into a full release.
